name: Northwest Communications Cooperative
old_description: Here at Northwest Communications Cooperative, we offer internet, telephone, video and security services that are top-of-the-line and, most importantly, delivered with a handshake and a smile. Based in Ray, North Dakota, we consider northwest North Dakota our neighborhood. Let us know how we can serve you.
about:
Northwest Communications Cooperative is a member-owned telecommunications cooperative headquartered in Ray, North Dakota. The cooperative serves communities across northwest North Dakota from its main office on Railroad Avenue and a secondary location in Williston. While the exact founding year is not publicly documented, the organization operates on a cooperative model, returning capital credits to its members and focusing on local service delivery.

The cooperative provides a suite of communications services including high-speed internet, landline and VoIP telephone (marketed as NCC iVoice), video entertainment through NCC Video+, and security monitoring for both residential and business customers. Operations are supported by a local technical team that handles installation, billing, and ongoing support such as remote troubleshooting and a customer portal for account management.

Customers range from individual households to small businesses and community institutions throughout the region. The cooperative’s service area emphasizes rural connectivity, and it participates in programs like the Foundation for Rural Service grant to support community development and education initiatives. Examples include providing broadband for local schools and sponsoring scholarships for area students.

NCC distinguishes itself through its member-first philosophy, stating that it exists for the benefit of its customers and aims to deliver high-quality, competitively priced services with a personal touch. The cooperative highlights its commitment to building strong local connections and reinvesting in the community through capital credits and donation programs.

old_description: Northwest Gourmet Foods produces fine dressings, sauces, mayonnaise and soups for food service, retail, and private-label clients.
about:
Founded in 1986, Northwest Gourmet Foods operates from Renton, Washington, producing salad dressings, sauces, mayonnaise, and soups for food service, retail, and private-label clients throughout the Pacific Northwest. With over 20 years of experience, the company positions itself as an industry leader in the region.

The company manufactures fresh refrigerated, shelf-stable, and hot-filled products. Its services include custom formulation development by an experienced R&D staff and packaging capabilities that span from 3/4-ounce individual portion cups up to 320-gallon totes. Production is described as highly efficient, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers range from food service operators and retail grocery chains to private-label brands that require contract manufacturing. The product portfolio focuses on dressings, sauces, mayonnaise, and soups tailored to both food service and retail specifications.

The company cites its custom formulation expertise and wide packaging versatility as factors that set it apart. It also maintains FDA compliance and HACCP certification, underscoring a commitment to food safety.

name: Norwalk Apparel Co.
old_description: Whether you're outfitting your staff, promoting your brand, or planning a school event, our team is here to help bring your vision to life. We offer top-quality embroidery and cutting-edge Direct-to-Film (DTF) printing services to give your gear a clean, professional look.
about:
Norwalk Apparel Co. operates from Norwalk, Connecticut, where it was founded by two passionate creatives with backgrounds in branding, apparel design, and small business growth. The pair launched the company to give local businesses and organizations the tools to represent themselves with confidence and style, staying hands-on with every order from design to final stitch.

The shop provides custom apparel decoration through three primary processes: Direct-to-Film (DTF) printing, embroidery, and vinyl decals. DTF transfers are produced on an Epson SureColor G6070, enabling vibrant, full-color prints on cotton, polyester, blends, and performance fabrics. Embroidery covers polos, hats, jackets, hoodies, uniforms, and bags, while vinyl decals serve vehicle lettering, storefront graphics, and equipment labeling. The company handles orders ranging from a single garment to large corporate runs and also supplies wholesale DTF transfers to other print shops.

Customers include businesses, schools, sports teams, fashion brands, event organizers, and fellow print shops. The company has outfitted employees with professional uniforms, produced spirit wear for schools, and created merchandise for fashion labels, in addition to providing wholesale transfers for screen-printing partners.

Norwalk Apparel Co. emphasizes fast turnaround times, competitive bulk pricing, and personalized customer service as its core differentiators. The founders frame the business as a partner rather than a vendor, aiming to help clients wear their identity proudly.

name: Nutmeg Table Company
old_description: Every Nutmeg piece is made to order. We build in small batches using primarily FAS-grade, kiln-dried American hardwood sourced from New England yards. Each piece is constructed in CT with a focus on quality and structural integrity. Before production begins, you’ll review detailed shop drawings for approval, followed by photos once the piece is complete and ready for shipping/delivery.
about:
Nutmeg Table Company operates from Waterbury, Connecticut, where it builds custom furniture in a workshop staffed by craftsmen. The business was founded by Steve, who leads a team that collaborates directly with clients on each piece. While the founding year is not publicly stated, the company has established a reputation for made-to-order production rooted in New England woodworking traditions.

The shop produces custom coffee tables, dining tables, butcher blocks, and vanities, all made to order in small batches. Every project begins with detailed shop drawings that the customer reviews and approves before any wood is cut. Materials are primarily FAS-grade, kiln-dried American hardwoods — walnut, maple, oak, and others — sourced from New England lumber yards and hand-selected in-house for each build. Finishes are sampled at the client's home to ensure compatibility with lighting and flooring.

The client base spans residential homeowners and interior designers across the Northeast. Designers can join a trade program for project pricing and support. Testimonials reference kitchen islands, eight-foot walnut dining tables, ribbed-leg coffee tables, and butcher blocks delivered to homes in Connecticut, New York, and greater New England. White-glove delivery covers New England and New York City; freight shipping reaches the rest of the country.

The company emphasizes structural integrity and a collaborative design process. Pieces are sized and finished for the specific space, with joinery modifications accommodated. The goal is furniture that fits the room and the life lived in it, built by hand in Connecticut from regionally sourced hardwood.

old_description: we offer a wide range of your communication construction needs. From make ready surveys, aerial, underground, splicing and emergency restoration. about:
O'Callaghan Cable Services, Inc. is based in Summerville, South Carolina, where it was established more than three decades ago. The company began as a local provider of telecommunication and cable construction services and has since expanded to handle projects across the United States.

The firm specializes in the construction, installation, and maintenance of fiber-optic and coaxial networks. Its crews perform aerial and underground cable placement, fiber blowing, microduct installation, fusion splicing, and electronic equipment installation for FTTx and cell-tower backhaul systems. The company also provides project management, inventory management, and full or partial turnkey delivery for network builds, upgrades, and rebuilds.

Customers include telecommunications carriers, broadband providers, and wireless infrastructure operators that require new builds, system upgrades, or emergency restoration after natural disasters such as hurricanes, tornadoes, and ice storms. The company’s emergency rapid-response teams are deployed nationwide to restore service after both weather events and man-made accidents.

O'Callaghan Cable Services emphasizes a highly trained workforce, clear communication with clients, and a commitment to completing projects on schedule and within budget. The company cites its decades of field experience and nationwide reach as the foundation of its reliability.

old_description: O'Neal Manufacturing Services (OMS) is a structural and heavy steel fabricator headquartered in Vestavia Hills, Alabama, part of O'Neal Industries, a metals manufacturing network active since 1921. OMS operates a dedicated structural steel fabrication plant in Fayette, Alabama, with a robotic beam line, plasma and saw cutting, and paint finishing for OEM and industrial construction customers.
about:
O'Neal Manufacturing Services (OMS) is headquartered in Vestavia Hills, Alabama, and operates as part of O'Neal Industries, a metals manufacturing network active since 1921. The company runs a dedicated structural steel fabrication plant in Fayette, Alabama, and manages a network of ten North American facilities stretching from Monterrey, Mexico, to Cedar Falls, Iowa.

OMS specializes in heavy steel fabrication, precision welding, complex CNC machining, and 5-axis laser processing, supported by advanced automation such as a robotic beam line, plasma and saw cutting, and paint finishing. The facilities produce high-volume repetitive parts, heavy-duty welded assemblies, and fabricated metal components for OEM supply chains, offering kitting and assembly as value-added services.

The company serves global OEMs in power generation, data centers, construction, material handling, transportation, and renewable energy. Its customer base includes Tier 1 partners in heavy equipment and infrastructure markets who rely on multi-site production for supply chain stability.

OMS differentiates itself through integrated multi-site manufacturing, providing a single point of contact for multi-step metal processing across its North American network. The company emphasizes proactive risk management, technical repeatability, and structural integrity, leveraging a century of industrial expertise to ensure on-time delivery and quality at scale.

about:
O'Reilly Auto Parts store #2814 operates at 3009 Northeast 72nd Drive in Vancouver, Washington. The location is part of the national O'Reilly Auto Parts chain, which serves both retail and professional customers across the United States.

The store stocks a broad range of auto parts and accessories for cars, trucks, SUVs, marine, lawn & garden, heavy-duty, power sport, and commercial vehicles. Key product categories include brake pads, rotors, calipers, radiators, thermostats, cooling system components, shocks, struts, suspension parts, tools, shop supplies, detailing products, batteries, motor oil, and oil filters. In addition to parts sales, the store provides free services such as battery testing and charging, alternator and starter testing, check engine light scanning with VeriScan, used oil and battery recycling, headlight and wiper blade installation with purchase, a loaner tool program with over 80 specialty tools, and in-store brake drum and rotor resurfacing.

Customers include DIY vehicle owners, professional technicians, and commercial fleets across automotive, heavy-duty, commercial, marine, lawn & garden, and power sport segments. The store supports routine maintenance, DIY repairs, and performance upgrades, with options for in-store shopping, online ordering, and free next-day delivery or in-store pickup.

The company emphasizes convenient services, knowledgeable staff, and a wide product selection to keep vehicles running at their best.

name: OMG Tooling Inc
old_description: OMG provides full-service plastic injection molding for OEM manufacturers. OMG offers over a century of experience in designing, tooling, and molding services. Taking your idea and placing it in the hands of consumers…
about:
OMG Tooling Inc was founded in 1980 by Oliver Marino Gerardi in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. Gerardi, known as the "original OMG," began by leasing a small space and operating a tool and die shop, sketching initial concepts on napkins before translating them into tooling and molds. His blend of art and science, combined with a passion for quality, established the company's foundation.

The company provides full-service plastic injection molding, encompassing custom design, in-house tooling fabrication, and molding of plastic components. OMG maintains tooling capabilities that many molders have eliminated, allowing it to build advanced tooling, enhance existing molds, and manage transfer tooling from other suppliers. Its automated molding processes aim to deliver consistent quality at competitive production rates, positioning the firm as a domestic alternative to overseas sourcing.

OMG serves original equipment manufacturers across a range of sectors, including consumer goods, healthcare, sports and leisure, construction, transportation, infrastructure, electronics, technology, and industrial markets. The company highlights its ability to accept existing molds as transfer tooling, supporting customers who need to relocate production or extend tool life.

The firm emphasizes its U.S.-based manufacturing and central Oklahoma location as strategic supply-chain advantages, promoting "Made in USA" integrity and protection against intellectual property risks associated with global supply chains. Core values articulated by the founder—integrity, excellence, quality, dedication, loyalty, and customer service—are cited as the bedrock of its operations.

name: OTHER Industries Custom Screen Printing & Embroidery
old_description: OTHER Industries is a studio specializing in custom screen printing, embroidery, promo products and bulk wholesale apparel production located in Wilmington, Delaware. With over 10 years of experience, we produce high quality custom printed t-shirts, branded merchandise, and large scale production runs with fast, reliable turnaround times. We are a trusted vendor for brands, businesses, and organizations that need consistent results and dependable production.
about:
OTHER Industries operates from Wilmington, Delaware, where it began over a decade ago as a basement operation printing shirts for the founders' own clothing projects. The studio grew from those DIY roots into a full‑service apparel production facility, shaped by the graphic‑design and printmaking communities of nearby Philadelphia.

The company provides custom screen printing, embroidery, promotional‑product sourcing, and wholesale apparel manufacturing. All production is kept in‑house at the Wilmington location, where experienced printers handle artwork review, screen setup, printing, and quality control. The shop works with plastisol, water‑based, and discharge inks, offers Pantone color matching, and runs specialty inks such as puff, glow‑in‑the‑dark, metallic, reflective, glitter, suede, plush, high‑density, texture, and stretch formulations. Orders start at 24 pieces for screen printing and scale from small‑batch runs to large wholesale volumes.

Clients span clothing brands, restaurants and coffee shops, construction and trade firms, schools and universities, corporate organizations, artists and bands, festivals and live‑event producers, nonprofits, breweries and hospitality groups, and retail merchandise programs. The studio decorates a wide range of garments including T‑shirts, hoodies, long‑sleeve shirts, tanks, athletic and performance wear, work shirts, safety apparel, polos, tote bags, aprons, jackets, sweatpants, and shorts.

The founders chose the name OTHER Industries to signal a departure from traditional print shops, aiming for a studio more connected to design, music, and independent brand culture. Their approach balances design awareness, technical experience, and hands‑on craftsmanship, with a dedicated sales representative guiding each order from garment selection through finished delivery.

name: OVERTAKE
old_description: In 2019, Justin Grimm sold his previous company to a private equity firm. Very soon after, he realized that the original values of the company started to slip away. He also realized this was not only happening with his own company, it was unfortunately becoming a frequent thing in the aftermarket community. He saw the soul of the automotive scene slipping away. The smaller shops, the craftsmanship, the community-focused values — all were being overshadowed by corporate giants more interested in profits than passion. So, he took a step back, reimagined the future, and founded OVERTAKE to give enthusiasts, like you, the parts, service, and attention to detail that you deserve.
about:
OVERTAKE is based in St. Paul, Minnesota, and was founded in 2019 by Justin Grimm. After selling his previous automotive business to a private equity firm, Grimm observed that the original values of craftsmanship and community focus were eroding across the aftermarket sector. He established OVERTAKE to restore enthusiast-driven service and attention to detail for the Subaru community.

The company designs and manufactures performance parts for Subaru vehicles spanning WRX, STI, BRZ/86, Forester, Crosstrek, Impreza, Outback, Legacy, and Ascent models. Product lines include top-mount intercoolers, gasket sets for H6 engines, transmission mount inserts, post-MAF pipe kits, cam solenoid heat shields, and various accessories. Operations emphasize crowd-sourced development through a dedicated Facebook group where enthusiasts provide feedback before production.

OVERTAKE serves the automotive aftermarket, specifically Subaru performance enthusiasts, independent repair shops, and racing teams. The company supports contingency racing sponsorships and influencer partnerships, and maintains a dealer network for wholesale distribution. Hero discounts are offered to military personnel, teachers, and healthcare workers.

The founder states the business was started to counter a trend where corporate ownership prioritizes profit over passion. Differentiators include same-day shipping on orders placed by 2 p.m. CST, a 30-day return policy, free shipping on orders over $250 within the lower 48 states, and a pricing philosophy that aims to keep custom-engineered products accessible.
